description:
DevTools Pro puts every page-inspection tool in one extension, and every tool is free. No account, no paywall.

No warning to install: it only touches the page you click it on. DevTools Pro asks for no access to your sites. It runs on a tab only after you click its icon there and pick a tool.

13 TOOLS, ALL FREE
- CSS Inspector: computed CSS by category, with the rule and stylesheet each value came from. Copy an element as CSS (C) or as Tailwind classes (T).
- Color Picker and Eyedropper: hover colours in hex, rgb, hsl and oklch, with WCAG AA and AAA contrast against the background actually behind the text. Pick any pixel with the eyedropper (E). See every colour on the page with the palette (P).
- Font Detector (what font is this?): the font the browser actually renders, not just the one declared. Sizes in px and rem, and every font on the page (I).
- Measure (page ruler): sizes on hover. Click to anchor an element, hold Alt for the distance to any other, or drag to measure an area.
- Grid Overlay: draws CSS grid tracks, gaps and named areas, and flexbox items and gaps, on the page. Keep several at once.
- Spacing: margins and padding tinted on the page, with their values.
- Accessibility Checker: a page-wide contrast audit plus alt text, labels, headings, landmarks and focus order. Every finding has a WCAG reference and a Highlight button that shows it on the page.
- Live Edit: change text, spacing, colours and font size on the page you are viewing, with real undo (Cmd/Ctrl+Z), reset, and copy your changes as CSS. Edits stay in your browser tab and are gone when you reload.
- Screenshot: the visible area, the full page, or one element. Saved as PNG and copied to the clipboard.
- Element Info: tag, classes, size, position and a copyable selector.
- CSS Variables: every custom property, grouped by scope, with colour swatches. Click to copy.
- Page Meta: title, meta, Open Graph and Twitter tags.
- Page Assets: images, scripts, stylesheets and fonts.

WORKS WHERE OTHERS STOP
- Inside same-origin iframes and inside web components, including closed shadow roots.
- On pages with a strict Content Security Policy.
- The inspector draws in its own isolated layer, so the page's styles cannot break it.
- Nothing runs on a page until you pick a tool, and hovering stays smooth on heavy pages.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account, no tracking, no ads. Nothing you inspect leaves your browser.
- Three permissions only: activeTab, scripting and storage.

KEYS WHILE A TOOL IS ON
Esc exits. Click pins the panel. S screenshots an element. C and T copy CSS or Tailwind. E and P open the eyedropper and palette. I lists page fonts. Alt measures distances. Cmd/Ctrl+Z undoes a live edit.

Built by Brightbar (brightbar.dev).
single_purpose: Inspect and debug the design of the web page the user is viewing, on demand: computed and authored CSS, colours and contrast, fonts, spacing, measurements, grid and flex layout, accessibility, CSS variables, meta tags and assets, with screenshots and temporary live edits of that page.

permission_justifications.activeTab: Grants access to the current tab only when the user clicks the DevTools Pro toolbar icon on that tab. The inspector then reads computed styles, element attributes and meta tags on that one page, and the Screenshot tool captures that tab. Without that click the extension has no access to any page.
permission_justifications.storage: Saves the user's settings (theme, compact panel) and the Color Picker's recent colour picks locally on the device. Nothing is transmitted.
permission_justifications.scripting: Injects the inspector (hover outline, floating info panel, drawn overlays and tool bar) into the tab the user opened DevTools Pro on, and only after they pick a tool. There is no content script that runs automatically, and nothing is injected into any other page. Live Edit applies the user's own edits to that page only when they make them; the edits stay in that tab and are gone on reload.
